category.instructions: Which category best describes this content?

criteria.Reminder: Calendar events that are upcoming in date or time and need reminding'.
criteria.Low Importance: Content of low importance and is considered 'Low Importance'.
criteria.Super Important: Content that needs immediate attention and is considered 'Super Important'.
criteria.Daily: Content that is related to daily activities or matters.
criteria.Internal Management: Content that is from an internal email and related to internal Microsoft management or administrative matters.
criteria.Internal Memo: Content that is from an internal email and related to internal Microsoft content or information.
criteria.Followup: Content that is time sensitive and needs follow-up.
criteria.External Spam: Content where the sender is from a domain external to the organization and is considered spam.
criteria.Training: Content related to training or learning, school activities, or educational content.
